touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Whaplode qualifies as a local detour through CHURCH OF ST MARY and Churchyard cross, St Mary's churchyard. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Whaplode: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Whaplode offers CHURCH OF ST MARY, Churchyard cross, St Mary's churchyard, CROSS APPROXIMATELY 15 METRES TO NORTH-EAST OF CHURCH within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: CHURCH OF ST MARY
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with CHURCH OF ST MARY and Churchyard cross, St Mary's churchyard, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.

dontMiss: CROSS APPROXIMATELY 15 METRES TO NORTH-EAST OF CHURCH
